definitions.short: Jehoshaphat , the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem
definitions.full: H3092. Yehoshaphat יוֺשָׁפָט יְהוֺשָׁפָט, proper name, masculine ᵐ5 Ἰωσαφαθ , Ἰωσαφατ ( ׳י hath judged , compare שְׁפַטְיָהוּ אֱלִישָׁפָט, & references) — 1 ׳יְהוֺ (so all except 5 & 6 ) king of Judah, son of Asa 1Kin 15:24 ; 22:2 21 t. 1Kings; 2Kin 1:17 ; 3:1 , 7 , 11 , 12 (twice in verse); 3:14 ; 8:16 (twice in verse); 12:19 ; 1Chr 3:10 ; 2Chr 17:1 40t. 2 Chronicles. 2 father of Jehu king of Israel 2Kin 9:2 , 14 . 3 chronicler under David & Solomon, son of Ahilud 2Sam 8:16 ; 1Kin 4:3 ; 1Chr 18:15 ; also 2Sam 20:24 ( ᵐ5 L Σαφαν ). 4 one of Solomon's 12 officers who provided victuals for the royal household 1Kin 4:17 ( ᵐ5 L Ἰωασαφατ ). 5 ׳יוֺ one of David's heroes 1Chr 11:43 . 6 ׳יוֺ a priest & trumpeter in David's time 1Chr 15:24 . 7 in proper name, of a location יְהוֺשָׁפָט עֵמֶק Joel 1Chr 4:2 , 12 , symbolical name of a valley near Jerusalem, place of ultimate judgement.
